commands.name: init

options.name: --name

options.name: --dry-run

arguments.name: module

options.description: Show what would change, without writing.

options.name: --offline
options.description: No network: do not fetch the repositories.

options.name: --adopt

options.name: --parent-ref
options.description: Read the parent from its remote, on this branch (to try what it gives, without versioning the choice).

commands.name: doctor

commands.name: mount list
commands.description: The mounts of mounts.yaml: where, their mode, whether they are required and whether they are here.

options.name: --all

commands.name: mount park
commands.description: Park mounts: their clones go to _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.

arguments.name: names
arguments.description: Mounts of mounts.yaml.

arguments.name: names

commands.description: Fast-forward the mounts here that have a clean working tree.

arguments.name: names
arguments.description: Only these mounts (without names, all).

commands.name: mount add
commands.description: Add a mount to mounts.yaml, where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: The URL to clone it from.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Where it is mounted, relative to the space: the layout is yours.

options.name: --name
options.description: Its name (by default, from the URL: Fuxion-docs.git → fuxion-docs).

options.name: --required
options.description: Required: always there, it cannot be parked (by default, each copy parks it or brings it back).

options.name: --mode
options.description: Its mode: write (by default), read-only or propose-only.

options.name: --guest
options.description: A guest: the space uses it, but it inherits from its own parent (inherits: false).

options.name: --depends-on
options.description: The mounts it needs.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Its tags.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show the change, without writing it.

commands.name: mount remove
commands.description: Take a mount out of mounts.yaml; its clone stays.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The mount.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show the change, without writing it.

arguments.name: tags

options.name: --remove
options.description: Remove the tags instead of adding them.

options.name: --dry-run

commands.name: doc check
commands.description: Checks the documents of the catalog, or the ones given: their sidecars, names, places, titles, relations, links and integrity.

arguments.description: Documents: paths (of the Markdown, of the sidecar, or a folder) or identities; none, the whole catalog.

options.description: Who makes the change, one of the actors of docs.yaml; by default, the variable FX_DOCS_ACTOR. new, adopt and key need it, and entry add when it reserves a key.

exitCodes.meaning: Done, without errors (there may be warnings).
Done, with errors: the diagnostics say which and how to fix them.
Wrong usage: an unknown command or option, a missing value, or something fx would ask with no one to ask.
